children: Tourist arrivals in Slovenia rose by 6.0% year-on-year to 1,286 million in August 2026 from an eleven-month high of 10.6% growth in the previous month.
This marked the highest number of arrivals on record.

Foreign tourist arrivals increased by 7.6% to 1,116 million, with visitors mainly coming from the Czech Republic (8.6%), Italy (8.3%), and Germany (6.7%), offsetting the declines in the Netherlands (-3.6%) and France (-4.5%).
Meanwhile, domestic tourism fell by 3.5% to 169.8 thousand.
Overnight stays went up by 5.8% to 3,537 million, with most tourists staying in mountain municipalities (7.7%), urban municipalities (6.4%), the capital (5.5%), and health resorts (5.4%).
For the January–August period, tourist arrivals grew by 6.4% year-on-year to 5,390.5 million, while overnight stays also rose by 6.4% to 14,078.4 million.

title: Slovenia Tourist Arrivals Reach Record in August
